name: Forte Metals
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) generated zero spend, leads, or clicks over the past 28 days, suggesting campaigns are paused or inactive. GBP drove all 93 organic actions (5 calls, 47 directions, 41 web clicks), but GBP activity dropped 100% in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, which is the biggest movement and likely signals a listing issue or a sharp drop in local search visibility.

performance.verdict: GBP collapse and 6 overdue SOW milestones are the real risks now.

findings.text: GBP dropped -100% in the last 7 days (0 actions vs. prior-week baseline of 12 actions on 2026-08-28); all organic lead pipeline is now dark.
4 CRM & Automation milestones overdue (earliest: 2026-07-07): 1st Directives, Tom call list, dedup workbook, and 342-stub reconciliation (blocker) — none show a completion event.
Web/SEO blocker overdue since 2026-08-31: root cause not yet named or submitted, gating downstream SEO and GBP visibility work.
Outreach blocker overdue since 2026-08-31: AGS + Forte contact lists not pulled, halting cold email sequences for both entities.

Search clicks fell -62.5% last 7 days (to near-zero from a series peak of 5 on 2026-08-25); 3-day signal (Sep 2–4) averages 0.67 vs. prior 3-day (Aug 30–Sep 1) average of 1.0 — directional decline, not noise.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately — verify it is published, not suspended, and owner-verified; GBP drove all 93 prior actions.
